info.name: SasaPay Merchant API
info.description:
SasaPay Merchant API collection (api/v1) - covers Customer to Business (C2B), Business to Customer (B2C), Business to Business (B2B), Checkout/Card Payments, Remittances, Utilities, Channel Codes, Account Validation, Internal Fund Movement, Transaction Status, and Account Balance.

This is a separate API family from the SasaPay WaaS (Wallet as a Service) API - the base URLs, auth endpoint, and some response field names (e.g. `detail` instead of `message`) differ, so this collection has its own environments.

How to use:
1. Select the `SasaPay Merchant - Sandbox` or `SasaPay Merchant - Production` environment.
2. Fill in `client_id` and `client_secret`.
3. Run `Get Access Token` in the Authentication folder. Its test script automatically saves `merchant_access_token` into the active environment.
4. All other requests use `Bearer {{merchant_access_token}}` automatically via the collection-level Authorization setting.

Note: this collection shares its environment with the SasaPay WaaS collection. Merchant-API-specific variables are prefixed `merchant_` (e.g. `merchant_base_url`, `merchant_access_token`) to avoid clashing with the WaaS collection's `waas_` prefixed variables.

request.description:
Exchange your Client ID and Client Secret for a Bearer access token via the OAuth2 `client_credentials` grant. Same mechanics as the WaaS token endpoint, but this issues a **separate token** since this API sits on `/api/v1` rather than `/api/v2/waas`.

**Auth:** Basic Auth over HTTPS — base64(client_id:client_secret), using `{{client_id}}` / `{{client_secret}}`.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| grant_type | Yes | Must be `client_credentials` |

**Response**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| status | true/false outcome |
| detail | "SUCCESS" |
| access_token | Bearer token to use on all other Merchant API requests |
| expires_in | Token lifetime in seconds (typically 3600) |
| token_type | "Bearer" |
| scope | Services this app is subscribed to, e.g. "merchants C2B/B2B/B2C" |

The Tests script saves `merchant_access_token`, `merchant_token_type`, `merchant_token_expiry`, `merchant_token_scope` into the active environment automatically.

Request payment (pull) from a customer via SasaPay wallet, M-PESA, Airtel Money, or T-Kash. A single endpoint handles all channels — behavior depends on `NetworkCode`.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your Paybill/Till number |
| NetworkCode | String | Yes | See options below |
| PhoneNumber | String | Yes | Customer's phone, format 254... |
| Amount | String | Yes | Amount to collect |
| Currency | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| AccountReference | String | Yes | Your transaction identifier |
| TransactionDesc | String | Yes | Description |
| CallBackURL | String | Yes | Final result URL |

**NetworkCode options**
| Value | Channel | Flow |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | SasaPay wallet | Sends a 6-digit OTP — complete with Process Payment |
| 63902 | M-PESA | Sends an STK push — no OTP/Process Payment step needed |
| 63903 | Airtel Money | Sends an STK push |
| 63907 | T-Kash | Sends an STK push |

Bank destinations return a reference for use as narration in Pesalink.

**Response**
`PaymentGateway`, `CheckoutRequestID` (save for Process Payment / status checks), `TransactionReference`, `CustomerMessage` (manual USSD instructions), `ResponseCode` ("0" = accepted & queued).

Completes a C2B request for the **SasaPay wallet channel only** (NetworkCode "0"), using the OTP the customer received. Not needed for M-PESA/Airtel/T-Kash STK push flows.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| CheckoutRequestID | String | Yes | From the Payment Request response |
| VerificationCode | String | Yes | 6-digit OTP |

**Response:** `status`, `detail` (e.g. "Transaction is being processed"). Final result is delivered to the `CallBackURL` from the original request.

Send money from your merchant account to a customer — salary payments, promotional payouts, loan disbursements, financial-institution withdrawals, etc. Funds are debited from the **Utility Account** label (use Internal Fund Movement first if it needs topping up from Working Account).

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| Amount | String | Yes | Amount to send |
| Currency | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| MerchantTransactionReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| ReceiverNumber | String | Yes | Recipient's mobile or bank account, with country code |
| Channel | String | Yes | "0" = SasaPay, or a bank/mobile money code from Channel Codes |
| Reason | String | Yes | Purpose of payment |
| CallBackURL | String | Yes | Final result URL |

**Response**
`B2CRequestID`, `ConversationID`, `OriginatorConversationID`, `TransactionCharges`, `ResponseCode` ("0" = accepted & queued). Final result (with `RecipientName`, `ResultCode`, `MerchantAccountBalance`, etc.) is delivered to `CallBackURL`.

Transfer from your SasaPay Biller number to another SasaPay or M-PESA Biller number.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| MerchantTransactionReference | Alpha-Numeric | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| Currency | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| Amount | String | Yes | Amount to send |
| ReceiverMerchantCode | String | Yes | Destination Paybill/Till |
| AccountReference | String | Optional for TILL | Reference at the receiving business |
| ReceiverAccountType | String | Yes | "PAYBILL" or "TILL" |
| NetworkCode | String | Yes | "0" SasaPay, "63902" M-PESA |
| Reason | String | Yes | Purpose of payment |
| CallBackURL | String | Yes | Final result URL |

**Response**
`B2BRequestID`, `ConversationID`, `OriginatorConversationID`, `TransactionCharges`, `ResponseCode`. Final result delivered to `CallBackURL`.

request.description:
Generates a hosted SasaPay checkout page URL supporting SasaPay wallet, M-PESA, Airtel Money, T-Kash, and card payments — redirect your customer there to complete payment.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| Amount | String | Yes | Amount to charge |
| Reference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction reference |
| Description | String | Yes | Purpose of payment |
| Currency | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| PayerEmail | String | Yes | Payer's email |
| CallbackUrl | String | Yes | Async result URL |
| SuccessUrl / FailureUrl | String | Yes | Post-checkout redirect targets |
| RedirectEnabled | Boolean | Yes | If true, customer is redirected to SuccessUrl/FailureUrl after checkout |
| SasaPayWalletEnabled | Boolean | Yes | Show SasaPay wallet as a payment option |
| MpesaEnabled | Boolean | Yes | Show M-PESA as a payment option |
| AirtelEnabled | Boolean | Yes | Show Airtel Money as a payment option |
| CardEnabled | Boolean | Yes | Show card payment as an option |

**Response**
`CheckoutUrl` — redirect the customer here. Also `PaymentGateway`, `MerchantRequestID`, `CheckoutRequestID`, `ResponseCode`. Final result delivered to `CallbackUrl`.

Send a cross-border remittance disbursement to a recipient's mobile money or bank account, with full sender KYC fields for regulatory compliance.

**Key payload fields**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| MerchantTransactionReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| DestinationChannelCode / DestinationChannelName | String | Yes | e.g. "63902" / "M-PESA" — see Channel Codes |
| Currency | String | Yes | Destination currency, e.g. "KES" or "TZS" |
| Amount | String | Yes | Amount the recipient will receive |
| ReceiverPhoneNumber / ReceiverAccountNumber | String | Yes | Recipient's contact and account |
| AccountReference | String | Optional for TILL | Reference at the receiving business |
| ReceiverAccountType | String | Yes | "PAYBILL" or "TILL" |
| ReceiverAccountName | String | Yes | Recipient's name |
| ForeignCurrency | String | No | "CODE,RATE" e.g. "USD,1" |
| SenderPhoneNumber / SenderName | String | Yes | Sender details |
| SenderDOB | String | No | Sender's date of birth |
| SenderCountryISO | String | Yes | e.g. "GB" |
| SenderNationality | String | Yes | e.g. "British" |
| SenderIDType / SenderIDNumber | String | Yes | Sender's identification |
| SenderServiceProviderName | String | Yes | Platform the sender used |
| RemittancePurpose | String | Yes | Reason for the remittance |
| CallbackURL | String | Yes | Final result URL |
| Remarks | String | No | Free-text description |

**Response**
`RequestID`, `MerchantRequestID`, `TransactionCharges`, `ResponseCode`. Final result delivered to `CallbackURL`.

Pay for airtime or a bill on behalf of a customer. Note: field names differ slightly from the WaaS Utilities endpoint (`contactNumber` instead of `payerAccountNumber`; `amount` is an integer here).

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| transactionReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| serviceCode | String | Yes | See options below |
| contactNumber | String | Yes | Phone number to notify about the transaction |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Account being paid for (a phone number when purchasing airtime) |
| currencyCode | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| amount | Integer | Yes | Amount to pay |
| callbackUrl | URL | Yes | Final result URL |

**serviceCode options:** `AIRTIME`, `SP-SAFARICOM`, `SP-AIRTEL`, `SP-TELKOM` (plus other billers configured on your account, e.g. water/electricity)

**Response**
`detail`, `merchantReference`, `checkoutRequestId`. Final result (with `Pin`/`Units` for KPLC tokens or printable airtime) delivered to `callbackUrl`.

Look up a bill's amount due before paying it.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| serviceCode | String | Yes | e.g. "SP-NRB-WATER" |
| customerMobile | String | Yes | Mobile number linked to the bill account |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Bill account number |

**Response `data`**
`accountNumber`, `serviceCode`, `dueDate`, `dueAmount`, `currency`, `customerName`.

Returns the list of banks and their channel codes — used as the `Channel` / `DestinationChannelCode` value in B2C, B2B, and Remittance requests.

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{bank_name, bank_code}`.

Validate a destination account before sending money to it — confirms it exists and returns the account holder's name, helping avoid misdirected payouts.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchant_code | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| channel_code | String | Yes | From Channel Codes |
| account_number | String | Yes | Account/number being validated |
| account_type | Number | Yes | See options below |

**account_type options**
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | SasaPay |
| 1 | Mobile Money |
| 2 | M-PESA Paybill |
| 3 | M-PESA Till |
| 4 | Bank |

**Response (success)**
`account_details.channel_name`, `account_details.account_name` (the name to confirm against). On failure: `status: false`, `detail` (error reason, e.g. "Invalid data provided").

Move funds from your Working Account label to your Utility Account label within your own merchant account — typically needed to top up the Utility Account before running B2C/B2B payouts.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| amount | String | Yes | Amount to move |

**Response:** `status`, `message` (e.g. "SUCCESS,Transaction completed").

Query a transaction's status. Unlike the WaaS version of this endpoint, this call only **acknowledges** the request — the actual result is delivered asynchronously to the `CallbackUrl` you provide.

**Payload** — `MerchantCode` is mandatory; supply **at least one** of the other three fields.
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| CheckoutRequestId | String | One of these 3 | From the original request |
| MerchantTransactionReference | String | One of these 3 | Your original transaction reference |
| TransactionCode | String | One of these 3 | SasaPay's transaction code |
| CallbackUrl | String | Yes | Where the status result will be POSTed |

**Immediate response:** `status`, `message` (e.g. "Your request has been received. Check your callback url for response").

**Callback payload includes:** `TransactionType`, `TransactionDate`, `CheckoutId`, `TransactionAmount`, `Paid`, `AmountPaid`, `PaidDate`, `SourceChannel`, `DestinationChannel`.

Check the merchant's account balances across all account labels.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| MerchantCode | Yes | Your merchant code |

**Response `data`**
`CurrencyCode`, `OrgAccountBalance`, `Accounts[]` — each `{account_label, account_balance}` (e.g. Bulk Payment, Utility Account, Working Account).
